passed: The Reno trigger is a native button with an expanded state and a control relationship to the player panel.
The YouTube iframe has a descriptive title, and the panel provides a direct YouTube link if playback fails.
The panel has a close button and supports Escape; closing it removes the iframe source.
The stylesheet disables CSS animations and transitions when reduced motion is preferred.
notes: The Reno pattern loads an unmuted autoplay iframe on pointer hover. For a music player, use hover only to reveal the player; require deliberate button activation to start audio, with keyboard access and clear play/pause and close controls.

Verify the chosen YouTube content has accurate captions for relevant lyrics, speech, and sound cues (WCAG 1.2.2 A); provide a transcript if the content is audio-only (1.2.1 A). Caption availability and quality cannot be confirmed from these files.

Keep emoji rain decorative and out of the accessibility tree. Honor prefers-reduced-motion in both CSS and any JavaScript animation; if motion runs automatically for more than five seconds alongside other content, provide a way to pause, stop, or hide it.
